required_fixes.finding: The charter is built on four claims that accepted evidence contradicts. (1) 'today that field is empty on the served bundles' is false: relations[] carries 37/41/35 typed citation edges and the frozen RELATIONS criterion PASSES on all three bundles with endpoint_ok 1.0. (2) 'OUTLIER_VALIDITY ... citation graph total degree 0 -> DEGENERATE->FAIL under any variant' is false for two of three bundles: it passes and is non-degenerate on de-kapitalverletzung and fr-bail-entretien under the incumbent and under relevance_ordered; degeneracy is an it-responsabilita-medica-only fact. (3) The causal claim is false under the binding frozen rule: vendored/frontier_map_semantics/metrics.py outliers_metric(decisions) takes decisions only, builds a shared-citation graph from find_citations(body(d)) and never reads relations[], so populating relations[] cannot change OUTLIER_VALIDITY. (4) 'relations/citations can be revealed on selection' is already implemented and shipping in product/static/query.html showDetail() (typed citation edges filtered by source/target, rendered as '-> cite' / '<- cite par' with confidence).
required_fixes.consequence: The charter's stated deliverable is unreachable by its own method, its acceptance test (5) ('a control with all edges stripped must reproduce the accepted DEGENERATE->FAIL exactly') is unsatisfiable because the accepted verdict on de and fr is PASS, and its stop_promote_rule routes the resulting guaranteed, mis-caused negative into an owner product decision.
required_fixes.fix: Do not dispatch as written. Either withdraw the team and record in portfolio policy that the premise was tested against accepted evidence and rejected, or re-charter around the one true residue: whether hydrating decision text from the existing cache lifts shared-citation degree above zero on it-responsabilita-medica. Either way replace acceptance test (5) with a per-bundle control reproducing the accepted verdicts (de PASS, fr PASS, it DEGENERATE->FAIL), remove the 'relations field is empty' clause from why_now/hypothesis/product_capability, and state the cause any retained bounded-negative escalation would rest on.

required_fixes.finding: The new clause orders Core Evaluation to 'report OUTLIER_VALIDITY as EXPLICITLY DEGENERATE rather than as a silent criterion failure, because ... the served bundles carry a citation graph of total degree 0 so the frozen DEGENERATE clause fires under ANY layout'. On two of the three served bundles OUTLIER_VALIDITY passes and is non-degenerate (INCUMBENT_REPRODUCTION.json and SCORES_relevance_ordered.json both record value [0.0, 0.0198]/[0.0, 0.0207] for de and [0.0, 0.0386]/[0.0, 0.0408] for fr with pass true, degenerate false).
required_fixes.consequence: A gate is claim-bearing; this would write a wrong verdict into an evaluation artifact and mislabel a passing criterion as structurally unreachable.
required_fixes.fix: Replace with the per-bundle statement: the frozen rule's degenerate flag is reported as the rule defines it; it fires on it-responsabilita-medica because un-hydrated row bodies carry no citation strings, and does not fire on de or fr where the criterion passes. A gate must never report a passing criterion as degenerate.
